notes.title: Update - New Features
notes.notes:
Hey there,
the next batch of User wishes has been implemented: 
[list]
    [*]Pitch Control
    [*]Color Control
[/list]

You can now adjust the Range of the Theremin. Not only does it behave more like a real one, you may also choose a smaller range for more precision. This was done with the help of professional Theremin musician Hermigervill from Iceland. 

See here his first try and tuning suggestions(-24 / 24): 
[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iGnIt4p2v3k]Video[/url]

Also you can now choose the color of the Theremin with three simple RGB knobs.

Have fun!

Make awesome music ;)

hOSHI*
